overall_reason: Every text element on the checklist card, the heading 'Release checklist' included, is the same #777777 grey on white; the only other values are the #333333 'Open project' fill and its white label.

score.reason: T-PALETTE-ROLES finds one text level for heading, meta, rows and states, so the ink role is missing; the action and ground are fine, which keeps it at 5.

findings.title: Text greys are a fixed set
findings.where: all text in the card (h3 'Release checklist', 'Due Friday · 4 tasks', row labels, 'Ready', 'In review', '2 tasks remaining'), 1440 and 375, C:\Users\warwicka\Documents\unslop-runs-set2\P41\01-evidence\tiles\1440-00.png
findings.evidence: The palette table finds one text level: #777777 on 7 elements, including the h3 heading, with white only on the button label.
findings.before: Heading, meta, task and state text all in #777777
findings.after: A fixed set of greys with an ink step: the heading and task names in the darkest ink, meta and state one step lighter
findings.why: With one grey for every role the reader cannot tell title from meta by value; the card reads faded.

strengths: The action is the only dark fill (#333333) and survives the grayscale fold.
